title: The Changing Workplace
text:
Many experts believe that the job market will change dramatically over the next twenty years. Automation is already replacing some routine tasks, such as data entry and basic bookkeeping. However, new roles are also emerging, especially in areas like renewable energy and artificial intelligence. As a result, workers will need to keep learning new skills throughout their careers.

Because of this, many universities now offer short courses that focus on practical skills rather than long degrees. Some companies have also started to train their staff directly, so employees can move into new positions without leaving the company. Experts often advise young people to stay flexible and curious. In the future, adaptability may be more valuable than any single qualification.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what is already being replaced by automation?
options: Routine tasks such as data entry

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what do some companies do to help their staff?
options: They reduce the number of employees

questions.text: What can the reader infer from the first paragraph about workers in the future?
options: They will stop working after they finish school
They will need to keep learning throughout their lives
They will only work in renewable energy
They will not be affected by automation

questions.text: What is the writer's main message about success in future careers?
options: A single qualification will guarantee a good job
Being adaptable is likely to matter more than one qualification
Short courses are useless for employees
Young people should avoid learning new skills

vocabulary.definition: regular and repeated, happening in the same way each time
beginning to appear or become important
the ability to change in order to suit new conditions
a skill, certificate or degree that shows you are able to do a job

paragraph_translations: Muitos especialistas acreditam que o mercado de trabalho vai mudar drasticamente nos próximos vinte anos. A automação já está substituindo algumas tarefas rotineiras, como a entrada de dados e a contabilidade básica. No entanto, novas funções também estão surgindo, especialmente em áreas como energia renovável e inteligência artificial. Como resultado, os trabalhadores precisarão continuar aprendendo novas habilidades ao longo de suas carreiras.

Por causa disso, muitas universidades agora oferecem cursos curtos que se concentram em habilidades práticas, em vez de graduações longas. Algumas empresas também começaram a treinar seus funcionários diretamente, para que possam assumir novas posições sem deixar a empresa. Os especialistas costumam aconselhar os jovens a se manterem flexíveis e curiosos. No futuro, a adaptabilidade pode ser mais valiosa do que qualquer qualificação específica.
